spec.prompt_template: Photorealistic e-commerce hero render of a single-use prefilled syringe in a clear blister pack. Match the attached reference image EXACTLY and reproduce the whole pack faithfully — change ONLY the printed text on the backing card. SCENE: a clear thermoformed plastic blister clamshell standing vertical, containing one prefilled syringe with amber/orange liquid, visible plunger and finger flange, laid diagonally, plus a printed paper backing card behind it. CAMERA: straight-on front, blister vertically centered ~88% of frame height, portrait. LIGHTING: soft key top-left with gentle realistic reflections on the clear plastic; seamless very-light grey background, soft contact shadow. The printed backing card is a soft off-white / very light warm grey (NOT a glaring pure bright white) — keep its brightness slightly muted. ON THE BACKING CARD, small neat navy #1b2846 text, left-aligned: the 'Regenic|Lab' wordmark with cyan accent, the product name '{product_name}' (Montserrat SemiBold, largest on the card), {dose_clause}and a small muted-grey 'SC · Single-use Syringe'. TYPOGRAPHY DISCIPLINE: keep the card text small, crisp and legible exactly as in the reference; do not enlarge or add text elsewhere; if no dose is specified do NOT invent one. There is NO schedule badge. Do NOT print 'Novecy' or any third-party/compounder branding. Clean premium clinical pharmacy, sharp focus, sRGB. Portrait 648x934.
